extra_ops.title: List Agents
extra_ops.description: List the AI agents (voice, chat and message agent flows) on this account.

params.name: limit
params.description: Results per page, 1 to 20. Defaults to 20.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip. Defaults to 0.

params.name: name
params.description: Filter by name (substring match).

params.name: state
params.description: Filter by state: `DRAFT`, `ACTIVE` or `PAUSED`.

extra_ops.title: Create an Agent
extra_ops.description: Create an AI agent flow: a graph of typed nodes wired together with connections. It starts as a DRAFT and handles no traffic until published. If the name is taken, the server appends " 1", " 2" and so on, and returns the stored name.

params.name: name
params.description: Agent name.

params.name: description
params.description: Agent description.

params.name: nodes
params.description: The flow's typed nodes; see List Agent Node Types for the catalogue and Retrieve an Agent Node Type for each node's `config` schema. Every node must be referenced by at least one connection, or the request is rejected (422) naming the orphaned node ids.

params.name: connections
params.description: Edges between nodes, each `{"source": "<node_id>.<handle>", "target": "<node_id>.<handle>"}`, for example `start-1.message` or `reply-1.Input`. A bare node id with no handle is rejected (400).

extra_ops.title: Retrieve an Agent
extra_ops.description: Get an agent flow's full definition: fields, state, nodes and connections. Secret values in node configs come back as `***REDACTED***`.

params.name: agent_id
params.description: The agent's UUID, from List Agents.

extra_ops.title: Update an Agent
extra_ops.description: Rename an agent flow (`name` alone), or replace its whole graph (`nodes` and `connections` together). `description` with `name` but no graph is rejected (400). `nodes` is a full replacement: to remove nodes, leave them out and set `allow_node_deletion`; no connection may still point at a removed node. `***REDACTED***` sent back from Retrieve an Agent keeps the stored secret.

params.name: agent_id
params.description: The agent's UUID, from List Agents.

params.name: name
params.description: New agent name.

params.name: description
params.description: New description; send it with a full graph.

params.name: nodes
params.description: The flow's typed nodes; see List Agent Node Types for the catalogue and Retrieve an Agent Node Type for each node's `config` schema. Every node must be referenced by at least one connection, or the request is rejected (422) naming the orphaned node ids.

params.name: connections
params.description: Edges between nodes, each `{"source": "<node_id>.<handle>", "target": "<node_id>.<handle>"}`, for example `start-1.message` or `reply-1.Input`. A bare node id with no handle is rejected (400).

params.name: allow_node_deletion
params.description: Allow the `nodes` sent to remove the stored nodes they leave out. Without it the update is refused (422).

params.name: agent_id
params.description: The agent's UUID, from List Agents.

extra_ops.title: Publish an Agent
extra_ops.description: Publish an agent flow, moving it from DRAFT to ACTIVE so it starts handling traffic.

params.name: agent_id
params.description: The agent's UUID, from List Agents.

extra_ops.title: Pause an Agent
extra_ops.description: Pause an ACTIVE agent flow so it stops handling traffic.

params.name: agent_id
params.description: The agent's UUID, from List Agents.

extra_ops.title: Resume an Agent
extra_ops.description: Resume a PAUSED agent flow, returning it to ACTIVE.

params.name: agent_id
params.description: The agent's UUID, from List Agents.

extra_ops.title: List Agent Runs
extra_ops.description: List the runs (executions) of an agent flow.

params.name: agent_id
params.description: The agent's UUID, from List Agents.

params.name: limit
params.description: Results per page, 1 to 20. Defaults to 20.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip. Defaults to 0.

extra_ops.title: Retrieve an Agent Run
extra_ops.description: Get one run of an agent flow: status, logs and goal metrics.

params.name: agent_id
params.description: The agent's UUID, from List Agents.

params.name: run_id
params.description: The run's UUID, from List Agent Runs.

extra_ops.title: List Agent Node Types
extra_ops.description: List the node types available for building an agent flow's graph.

params.name: types
params.description: Comma-separated node types, to return only those.

params.name: limit
params.description: Results per page, 1 to 100. Defaults to 100.

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip. Defaults to 0.

extra_ops.title: Retrieve an Agent Node Type
extra_ops.description: Get the JSON Schema a node type's `config` must match, before wiring it into a flow with Create an Agent or Update an Agent. `x-plivo-coverage` lists server-side rules (conditional requirements, secret references) the schema cannot express.

params.name: node_type
params.description: A node type from List Agent Node Types.
